## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Tested on OPNsense where applicable
- [ ] `sh -n` passed for changed shell scripts
- [ ] `php -l` passed for changed PHP files
- [ ] `xmllint --noout` passed for changed XML files
- [ ] `git diff --check` passed
- [ ] Active runtime safety was tested where applicable
- [ ] No runtime files, backups, logs, binaries, or secrets were added

## Architecture

- [ ] The change preserves approved requirements
- [ ] Generic behavior was preferred over service-specific logic
- [ ] Documentation state was updated when the development milestone changed
